messages:
Alex (Support): Customer ticket #C-9145 reporting canary rollout GUI shows several canaries stuck 'in progress' for ~2.5h. They see no events in timeline and metrics panel is empty. Raised to us because their release is blocked.
Maya (Eng): Looking — which cluster / rollout id?
Alex (Support): rollout id=rollout-412 in prod-us-east, customer provided screenshot. Also seeing repeated 502s when calling /v1/rollouts/:id/status from the console.
Sam (SRE): I pulled logs from console-api and status-sync. Console shows polling loop hitting status-sync: `GET /status/rollout-412 -> 504` then `504` retries. status-sync pod `status-sync-0` has these in its logs: ```ERROR failed to fetch external events: context deadline exceeded
WARN reconcile timeout for rollout-412```.
Maya (Eng): Hmm. status-sync depends on kafka consumer for event stream. Any consumer lag?
Sam (SRE): kafka metrics show consumer group `status-sync` lag > 1M for topic `rollout-events-prod`. Looks like consumer fell behind around 1774999000.
Jordan (Product): Customer notes this only affects canary health charts (progress bars). Other routes seem fine. Is there a fallback in console if events are delayed?
Maya (Eng): Console currently only shows live event stream + last-known snapshot. If stream stalls and no snapshot, it stays in 'in progress'. We should surface a warning and fall back to snapshot. Short-term: we can restart status-sync consumer to catch up.
Alex (Support): Customer asks ETA and a workaround. Can we do restart now?
Sam (SRE): I'm going to trigger a rolling restart of status-sync statefulset (prod-us-east). Will post progress.
ops-bot: Started rollout: sts/status-sync -> rolling-restart by sam@redwood at 1775001850
Sam (SRE): Restart complete. Consumer group rebalanced. Lag dropping: 1M -> 200K -> 0 within ~6m.
Maya (Eng): Confirming console now receives events. I see the canary progress update events replaying.
Alex (Support): Customer reports charts moving again and that progress changed from 'in progress' to green for the first canary. They still see a gap in metrics from 10:12–10:28.
Jordan (Product): We should notify the customer about the root cause and mitigation. Also open an internal bug: console should fall back to latest snapshot and show a visible "events delayed" banner.
Maya (Eng): Filed issue #INF-2087: "Console: canary progress tiles remain 'in progress' when status-sync event stream lagging; add snapshot fallback + banner". Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-platform.
Sam (SRE): Notes for postmortem: consumer fell behind after a short GC spike on the kafka brokers, need to tune fetch.min.bytes and add consumer-side backpressure. Will attach broker GC timeline.
Alex (Support): I'll update the customer thread with timeline, workaround (we restarted status-sync), and link to INF-2087. They asked for an ETA on a UI patch — we'll say next-week sprint.
Maya (Eng): Quick followup: adding a monitoring alert for consumer lag > 100k and a console health endpoint that returns stale=true when no events for > 60s. I'll put a small PR up today.
Alex (Support): Thanks all. Customer appreciated fast action. Closing the support escalation but keeping INF-2087 tracked. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Product): +1. Also consider a short-term UI hotfix to show last-updated timestamp instead of indefinite 'in progress'.
Maya (Eng): Agreed, adding to the issue.
Sam (SRE): Leaving this thread open for any regressions.
Alex (Support): marking resolved from CS side at 1775003410
